description: Web scraping, crawling, search, and agentic extraction — the full Firecrawl v2 API, keyless.

product_demo.title: Full usage demo
product_demo.when_to_use: When you need content from the live web: read a page as clean markdown, search the web, enumerate a site's URLs, crawl a whole domain, or extract structured data from pages.

quickstart.goal: Read any page as clean, LLM-ready markdown
quickstart.expect: {"success":true,"data":{"markdown":"# Example Domain\n\nThis domain is for use in documentation examples...","metadata":{"title":"Example Domain","creditsUsed":1}}}

examples.note: Always map before a crawl: crawl defaults to 10000 pages.

operations.note: 20 credits at enqueue; a big crawl costs more upstream
50 credits — your whole budget in one call

cost.worked_total: This demo spends $0.0191 of your $0.0415 budget (search + map + crawl + the quickstart scrape; both reads are free).

gotchas: crawl defaults to limit 10000 and agent to maxCredits 2500 — always set them.
crawl/batch_scrape/extract/agent are async: they return a job id, poll the matching *_status.
402 = your budget is spent; reads and status polls still work.
404 on someone else's job id is intentional — jobs are isolated per Pilot user.
firecrawl.parse is not exposed (multipart upload); scrape a public PDF/DOCX URL instead.
Results cache up to 48h; pass maxAge:0 to force a fresh fetch.
